content: Claude Code Agent Skills live in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (markdown + frontmatter), cost ~100 tokens until invoked, and are purely instructional (no direct external access) — they guide Claude using existing session tools/MCP servers. Subagents are separate sessions with own context/tools, invoked when their description matches the task; only final message returns to parent. MCP servers provide the actual external access (browser control, APIs) but are context-expensive (~55k tokens for a 5-server setup). Recommended pattern: a SKILL.md that documents the QA workflow/checklists and instructs Claude to use an already-configured Playwright MCP server, optionally delegating heavy exploration to a subagent to keep the main context clean.
